answer: Vote by cross-branch quorum: a key counts only when separate vine clusters sign it, and each vine issues one ivory token per epoch to a newcomer never seen there. For the kth simultaneous key, one operator must collect k fresh ivory from k unrelated vines that epoch, while every signer locks velvet forfeited on correlated ballots. n clones need n distinct vines at once and n velvet stakes; rented or copied vines correlate and burn.
